requirement: Production APIs must not expose stack traces to the client.
prohibited: Returning raw exception tracebacks/stack traces in HTTP responses.
remediation: Return a generic error response externally; log the full traceback internally only.

requirement: Internal exception details (file paths, library versions, query text) must not be returned to clients.
prohibited: Including internal implementation details in an error message sent to the client.
bad_example: {"error": "psycopg2.OperationalError: could not connect to server at /var/run/postgresql"}
remediation: Strip internal details from client-facing error payloads.

requirement: Generic, custom error responses/pages must be returned externally for 403/404/405/500 conditions.
prohibited: Serving the framework's or server's default error page (which may reveal software name/version).
bad_example: # default Nginx 404 page with server version in footer
remediation: Configure custom error pages for all standard error codes.

requirement: Detailed error/exception information must only be written to internal logs, not returned in the response body.
prohibited: Duplicating full exception detail into both logs and the HTTP response.
remediation: Log full details server-side; return only a generic message to the client.
